supporting.purpose: diagrams in issues or pull requests that explain the event ontology, coverage windows or evidence links; not product marketing

brand-reference.purpose: the archived reference transcript is the only visual/audio anchor in the repository; no brand art is generated for this project

reject_when: fake metrics or invented precision numbers
an image that presents an interpretation as if it were an observation
tiny unreadable labels on a phone screen
screenshots that show keys, tokens or private file paths
